archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for Premium SaaS
mood: Professional, authoritative, clean, and highly organized.
design_philosophy: Enterprise dashboard shell reminiscent of Linear, Ramp, or Mercury. Content is king, organized via strict grids, generous whitespace, and high-contrast typography. Avoiding typical marketplace visual tropes.

app_shell.sidebar: w-64 border-r border-gray-200 bg-white h-screen flex flex-col fixed left-0 top-0
app_shell.top_nav: h-16 border-b border-gray-200 bg-white flex items-center justify-between px-6 sticky top-0 z-40 ml-64

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6
layout_and_spacing.card: bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] p-6 flex flex-col h-full

buttons.primary: bg-zinc-900 text-white rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-zinc-700 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors

badges.base: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border

inputs.default: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm placeholder:text-gray-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-zinc-900 focus:border-transparent transition-all

user_avatar.description: Professional female avatar for user menu

views_and_pages.dashboard: Role-gated grids (Buyer, Supplier, Admin) using Cards. Layout emphasizes metrics and recent activities. Use empty states where data is missing.
views_and_pages.workspace_page: A centralized view representing a specific transaction or context (RFQ, Order). Needs sections for Timeline (left/main area), Documents (right sidebar), Next Actions (top/prominent), and Participants (sidebar).

instructions_to_main_agent: Import Google Fonts for `Outfit` and `Inter` in the main CSS file.
Do NOT use a typical marketplace look. No large colorful banners or product grids. Treat this as an operations command center.
Use Shadcn UI components extensively for forms, buttons, dropdowns, and dialogs. Heavily customize their styles (especially border-radius and shadows) to match the premium, soft enterprise feel.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes as specified in testing rules.
Use the layout structure defined in `layout_and_spacing.app_shell` to build the core shell.
